# EGP Window — Business dashboard
Clinical usage overview. Data source: Application Insights `customMetrics` and `traces`.
See `docs/observability/metrics.md` for the metric catalogue and `docs/monitoring/queries.kusto.md` for query recipes.

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "egp.turn.count"
| where tostring(customDimensions.env) == "{env}"
| summarize turns=sum(value) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Turns per 5-minute bin

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "egp.turn.duration_ms"
| where tostring(customDimensions.env) == "{env}"
| summarize p50=percentile(value, 50), p95=percentile(value, 95), p99=percentile(value, 99) by bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Turn latency percentiles

content.query:
customMetrics
| where name == "egp.specialist.duration_ms"
| where tostring(customDimensions.env) == "{env}"
| summarize p95=percentile(value, 95) by domain=tostring(customDimensions.domain), bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Specialist p95 by domain
